justification: The replication correctly reproduces three mechanistic claims: (C1) zeta-band degeneracy vanishes to machine precision (~3e-16) at m=0 confirming PT-symmetry protection; (C2) linear-in-m splitting with slope~0.75 and residual<0.001 confirming the symmetry-breaking mechanism; (C3) finite damping-like SOT ~0.235 at m=0. However, the central quantitative headline—the magnitude of the EXTRA interband Berry-phase SOT unlocked by noncollinearity—is unresolved (raw Kubo sum at ~1e-18 numerical noise). The 2D bipartite model (Eq.9), m-threshold phase boundary, and DW-motion estimates are not reproduced.
caveats: The method limitation on the extra Berry SOT magnitude is the paper's primary quantitative result; only the enabling mechanism is demonstrated. Several supplementary analyses (Eq.9 model, threshold estimates) are entirely absent.
